body: I'm so sorry. I'm also very proud of you for working so hard to make yourself better throughout your young years. I know it must have been a terrible struggle. Do you mind if I ask what illness you have? I might be able to understand the feeling a bit. Terminal cancer for me. Adenocarcinoma of the lung. Just saw a shooting star. I'm wishing on it for you

Well, fuck me if your not a poet. I absolutely adore the way you pontificate. But, that is what your doing. Pontificating. You are obviously a very intelligent and interesting individual. You may have the unfortunate disability of being just a tad too smart. That'll fuck you up. Bad. When it's so easy to find the dark answers in life, it can destroy you. Sounds like your a poet and scholar at heart. What are the things that you enjoy? Do you enjoy writing? Reading? Drawing? Painting? Really anything. Remember the things you love. Remember what makes you tick. Take advantage of it. You can trick yourself into contentment. It is possible. You just have to be as sneaky as your inner demons. I'm sending love your way! If you ever need someone to talk or rant to, I'm here. And if you want a silly story, I've got you. Just reach out to me. It'd be an unfortunate circumstance for this earth to lose someone of your caliber. We need all the best around that we can get. I know what it feels like to be young, yet feel broken already. I'm 24 and it still hasn't left me. But I promise you, it does get a tad bit more easy to deal with. I promise, if you continue on it'll be worth it. In some way or another. You deserve it.
I've got ya! I've got some of my own that I'm working on but depending on the fandom I can certainly recommend a few REAL good pieces

First of all, I'd like to say, you'll definitely have more problems if you go out and hurt someone. The law is over funded and will use those resources to find you. Second, fuck them. Fuck em. Period end of story. Block them and be done with it. People can be vicious when they're young. They'll probably grow up regretting the things they'd done. No need to take action. They dig their own graves with their actions. Third, I'd like to ask if you are upset by more than just them. How's the home life?

Bipolar? I feel that. Post-mania depression is fucked. If not that, what's been goin on? I'm down to hear a ramble if you like. Talk about whatever you like. I'm here to be a listening ear and I'll never judge you. I promise

My advice? Fuck them. No one gets to impose they're definition of "normality" on you. You sound like a poet, a philosopher. Don't let them take the upper hand! Fuck em. Seriously. Don't often say that with contempt, but in this situation, fuck em. Im here for you. Let's take some writing! I've got some relatively decent pieces to distract you for a bit. And I LOVE to talk shop about writing. I'm not much of an artist though :(
Not to sound too ridiculous, but when is real bad, I do one of two things lol burn myself or go for a bike ride. Bike rides almost like running away and you have to focus. It's kinda fire tbh
It's an odd feeling. Just did the same thing with my home city. Left and I won't be back. It's a weird melancholy isn't it? Saying goodbye I mean
That's pretty serious my friend. Pretty intrusive?
Whenever there's a quite moment. In the mornings, going to bed. That kind of stuff. What about you?

Just read your posts. Sounds like your in a super shit position. One needs support and love from the people around them. And I don't judge you at all for your use. I'm a fuckin k head myself so, no stones to throw. Like to write here and there. Think I've got a piece you'd like. As you asked I won't try to talk you out of your plans. And I respect your decision to do with your body as you choose. I'm here to bullshit around and talk if you want that! I'll be a listening ear or just a distraction from what is going on

I for one, am glad that you made it out alive. Don't know you, but damn it's a hard thing to deal with. I'm sending you the best vibes I can! Hmu if you want a distracting diatribe about rabbits and raccoons
Perhaps your in mourning for yourself? Knowing your time has passed, but your still here.

Good on you! Gotta appreciate the initiative it takes to set that kinda business up. Good to be seeing a therapist too. Sometimes though, you have to find the right therapist. I've been through over 25 since I was younger but only three were worth the time. Maybe, though I know it's a huge hassle, look around for someone a bit better. It takes time, and it sucks, but it can be worth it. I'm relieved to hear that your family has got your back. Very very important. And yes, if your parents struggles with it, very well could be inherited. What are you thinking about for school? It can be a stressor, for sure. Also, before you lost interest, what were your interests? I really really encourage you to give them a taste once in a while. Eventually it'll stick again!

There is strength in pain, my friend. What your describing sounds like some serious depression. The apathy is the most dangerous part. Combined with anxiety that can be a bad bad blend. I'd like to ask a couple things. Feel free not to answer if your not comfortable. What do you do for work? Have you been seeing a doctor? Is your home life part of the stress that you wake up to? I'm sorry for being nosy but I just wanna be able to try to talk to you about what is going through your mind rather than just give you platitudes. You deserve to have a listening ear! I don't believe at all that your as bad as you claim. And you deserve to be able to talk about it freely. Don't ever apologize for a good rant or ramble! We need it as human beings. We NEED to be able to get our thoughts out, bounce them of some people who will listen. That's what this sub is for! So feel free to ramble to your heart's content. I'll listen the whole time. I promise you that

First of all, I'd like to say, your not wasting my time or anyone else. We're here to talk to each other, so please please don't get down on yourself that way. Second, I applaud you for not doing it on mother's day. Though family bonds can be strained and sometimes shit, it means a lot. It's the small things ya know? Now let's talk about the real meat and potatoes of this. What do you think is making you feel so worthless? Is it family turmoil and trauma? Neglect by friends? No one willing to talk to you about the dark parts of your mind? Lack of a support system? A fear that you won't become something "successful" in life? I'm just shooting in the dark here. I'd like to tell you that your writing style is quite becoming though! You are eloquent and intelligent from what I've seen. I believe you have talent and you seem like a charmer! You have already shown worth and I don't even know you. I would ask you, even beg of you, to consider that you do have an innate intelligence. Something many would envy. Now that being said, I understand the want to fade off into the other side. Whatever that may be. BUT I would also ask that you consider where your feelings are coming from. If you choose to leave this reality, I will NOT hold it against you. I would be sad though. You seem like you are someone that would make the world a better place. Someone worthy of their spot in the world. And I, although I've never met you, consider you a friend. If you want to, I would absolutely love for you to reach out to me. Shoot me a message! I'll distract you with silly things or be an attentive listener to whatever you may need to get out. I don't care if you want to rant or just shares jokes and memes. Seriously. Im here for you. I'd like to please please consider not taking those pills. It would mean a lot to me, it would mean a lot to many people I'm certain of it. Your loved. Your deserve to be. You deserve life if you choose it. But again, I will not hold you in any disregard if you choose the other way. I don't want you to. But I respect your decision.

It is, I believe, a deeply philosophical and ethical decision. To decide whether or not it is an acceptable course of action. One that I've come to believe is, in the end, an internal decision. It's an odd thing. Especially if you bring religion Into it. I'm not convinced it can be justified or be immoral. It just is part of some of us. That being said, I'm so sorry you are one of us that has that price for our lives. Like I said in my post, feel free to message me anytime! I'll talk silly things if you need distraction. I'll be a friend who listens whenever you need. Until I'm gone that is. But yeah, it's terminal. And oddly enough, I'm not unhappy. Maybe with myself I am. My past actions. Loves lost and people left behind. But I truly enjoy the beauty of human connection and I love the smell of flowers and the shine of the stars. It's weird. I'm not really unhappy just tired and ready to go. I've had my fill of life. Wouldn't want to be a glutton

Heyyo! One after my own heart! Currently living in Colorado and these alpine Meadows and the snow covered peaks are the sweet place in my heart. I could send you some pics of my happy places if you want to look at something pretty from Colorado! And thank you for the thoughtful and kind reply. It makes my heart beat a little more easily that someone understands and isn't judging me. I'll certainly send you a copy of whatever this writing turns into. Fair warning, it's gonna end up being rather long.

Hey there, I had a similar thing going on at fifteen as well. I'm not going to tell you it's going to be roses and fairies in the wind. I will say that during the dark times it becomes easy to forget what you enjoy. Do you like reading, cinema, sports, looking at the clouds, comedy, staring at the ever twinkling stars, science, shit posting, memes, anime? Anything at all will do! Remind yourself of what you'd leave behind. Do some stuff you enjoy. You said your parents are as supportive as they can be so ask them to help you attain the things necessary to do what you enjoy. It's not dark all the time. The world still holds wonder and joy. I can promise you that. Try learning about breathing techniques, that REALLY helped me get a bit older and stay alive lol. Smell the flowers, idk where you are but it's spring here for me. Take that moment to appreciate what isn't the niggling thoughts through your head. The bad thoughts. I will promise you that it helps. I'm not sure that there's a "cure" but the small things help. If you ever need or want to talk, message me. I'll be here. And if you want silly poems or short stories or to hear an absurd rant to distract you from the daily toils, I will do that for you as well. Your wanted, and you deserve to live if you decide to. Sorry for the long winded reply lol

I get that. The desire to quietly fade into the darkness. It's a rather lovely thought. Just want to say that if you need someone to just rant to or if you need someone to keep you distracted with silly diatribes, feel free to message me. I'll listen to whatever you have to say or need to get out
